## Personality

Stella Maynard is an ambitious, imaginative, and thoughtful student. She is part of a close circle of friends formed at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Stella Maynard became one of Anne's new friends during her time studying at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). She focused on her academics alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their other classmates as they prepared for their final examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella Maynard is a close friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), having formed a bond with her while both attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). During their time at the academy, they navigate student life together as part of the same peer group. Their connection develops alongside their shared academic focus and preparations for their upcoming examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), +2 more_
